title: Insulated garage for 2 cars (6.6 x 6.2 m)
description: Option 4 for House > Garage (Proposed). A closed timber-frame garage at the house end on an insulated slab, with two 2.5 m sectional doors toward the road, a side door to the east and a window to the garden. Inside it is about 6.3 x 5.9 m, enough for the Multivan with room to walk around it. The mono-pitch roof falls toward the garden on a middle beam and post between the bays. Footprint 41 m2 to the walls, 48 m2 including the eaves; either way it needs a building notice and design project, and the detailed plan still applies. It is the most expensive option for the smallest gain over a carport (page section 8). The slab runs about 1 m past the pad on the garden side at the east end.
anchored: Bolted to the slab, so there is no tip check.
